# 调查报告：2023 Türkiye–Syria earthquakes on February 6, 2023 (Mw 7.8 mainshock)

> **覆盖率** 8/15 适用槽位（80%）　**事实** 10 条　**结论级双源支持** 0/10　**来源 episode** 8 个

> 本报告仅消费图谱证据包。每条结论都标注了来源 episode；无证据的槽位如实标记为未查到，不做推断补全。

## WHO

**Primary Actor**
  - The two major 6 February earthquakes (together referred to as the Kahramanmaraş earthquake sequence) occurred on separate faults branching off the 600-kilometer-long (380-mile-long) East Anatolian Fault, which runs through eastern Türkiye and south into Syria, separating the Anatolian and Arabian tectonic plates. `ecc2e064`
    ⚠️ claim has 1 independent source(s); 2 required；no verified date: this source did not state one explicitly；single source; no claim-level corroboration
  来源：[The 2023 Türkiye-Syria Earthquakes Shifted Stress in the Crust](https://eos.org/features/the-2023-turkiye-syria-earthquakes-shifted-stress-in-the-crust)

**Affected Parties**
  - In Türkiye, where an estimated 9 million people were affected, the needs remain high for a population that is experiencing widespread displacement. `483fa693`
    ⚠️ no verified date: this source did not state one explicitly；single source; no claim-level corroboration
  - Two strong earthquakes struck southeast Türkiye and northwest Syria on Feb. 6, killing over 41,000 people. `483fa693`
    ⚠️ no verified date: this source did not state one explicitly；single source; no claim-level corroboration
  来源：[2023 Türkiye & Syria Earthquakes Response: Situation Report #7, February 15, 2023 - Türkiye | ReliefWeb](https://reliefweb.int/report/turkiye/2023-turkiye-syria-earthquakes-response-situation-report-7-february-15-2023)

**Related Organizations**
  - Project HOPE’s Emergency Response Team is on the ground to support survivors and is working with partners to carry out search and rescue. `d53e0e12`
    ⚠️ no verified date: this source did not state one explicitly；single source; no claim-level corroboration
  - Project HOPE’s partner, SAMU, has K-9 search and rescue teams on the ground in the earthquake zone. `d53e0e12`
    ⚠️ no verified date: this source did not state one explicitly；single source; no claim-level corroboration
  来源：[2023 Türkiye & Syria EARTHQUAKES RESPONSE](https://abfe.issuelab.org/resources/41661/41661.pdf)

**Regulators** — ⚠️ 未查到相关证据

## WHAT

**Core Event**
  - In the early hours of 6 February 2023, a magnitude 7.8 earthquake struck southern Türkiye. Just 9 hours later, a magnitude 7.5 earthquake hit 90 kilometers (60 miles) to the north. `fe0baa46`
    ⚠️ claim has 1 independent source(s); 2 required；single source; no claim-level corroboration
  来源：[The 2023 Türkiye-Syria Earthquakes Shifted Stress in the Crust - Eos](https://eos.org/features/the-2023-turkiye-syria-earthquakes-shifted-stress-in-the-crust)

## WHEN

**Trigger**
  - One of the reasons quakes like this are so devastating — aside from the massive size and shallow depth, and aside from the fact that it struck in a heavily populated area — is that buildings in the region are not built to withstand large earthquakes. `d68cfc10`
    ⚠️ claim has 1 independent source(s); 2 required；no verified date: this source did not state one explicitly；single source; no claim-level corroboration
  来源：[Turkey and Syria devastated by earthquake - Temblor.net](https://temblor.net/earthquake-insights/turkey-syria-earthquake-feb-6-2023-14918)

## HOW

**Mechanism**
  - The earthquake rupture terminated near Suvatlı in the Amik Valley, where some 10.5 km (6.5 mi) to its east is the Hacıpaşa Fault, a Dead Sea Transform segment. The rupture was arrested by a stepover that connects the East Anatolian Fault with the Hacıpaşa Fault. `5f0df53c`
